Reranking where NVIDIA NIM lists the scored documents under rankings with a logit

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\RerankRequest;
$req = \Liter\Llm\RerankRequest::from_json(json_encode(["documents" => ["The weather is sunny today.", "Deep learning uses neural networks.", "Machine learning is a subset of AI."], "model" => "nvidia_nim/nv-rerankqa", "query" => "What is machine learning?"]));
$apiKey = getenv('API_KEY');
if ($apiKey === false || $apiKey === '') {
    throw new RuntimeException('API_KEY must be set');
}
$client = LiterLlm::createClient($apiKey);
$result = $client->rerank($req);
var_dump($result->getResults());
var_dump($result->getResults()[0]->relevanceScore);
```
